name: Starry Wings of Gloceana
name_jp: 極星グロシアーナの翼
effects:
Max HP +2000 to party, Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Starry Wing of Gloceana to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 1, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Starry Wing of Gloceana: [Damage] or [Fire Damage] +5% to party if user has/does not have Realm Synergy
Interval Chase: [10 single-target Prismatic/NE white magic attacks] or [Single-target minor DeShell for 5 seconds] & [Damage] or [Fire Damage] +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases if user has/does not have Realm Synergy (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE piercing white magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast 1 to party & Quick ATB 1 to En-Fire members, removes Master Mode
